programs.title: Hey Duggee
programs.desc: Duggee struggles to organise the Squirrels in order of height and keeping them focused on the task. Sounds like the Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.

programs.title: Maddie & Triggs
programs.desc: While donating some old items to Higgledy Heros charity shop, Maddie has doubts about giving away her old xylophone - can she really let go of her very first musical instrument?!

programs.title: Play School: Make and Create
programs.desc: Rachael and Teo get creative making swirly whirly marbling patterns on paper and fabric. They create a paper puppet world, and Teo uses the marbled fabric to make a fun hat to twist and shake in!

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: Sarah and Mandy are filming a piece for the Scoop Dooley Show, and Scoop Dooley is trying to make everything more 'sensational.'.

programs.title: Santiago of the Seas
programs.sub_title: Santiago's Greatest Treasure / The Golden Banana Treasure
programs.desc: When Bonnie Bones steals a chest of pirate treasures, Santiago learns just how much he needs his crew. / Santi and crew navigate the tricky Banana Island to save a baby monkey and its treasure from Enrique.

programs.title: PJ Masks
programs.sub_title: Pj Masks: The Power Of Mystery Mountain
programs.desc: Mystery Mountain breaks out of its dimension and floats over the city, the heroes band together to save the day.

programs.title: Mecha Builders
programs.desc: A giant pie is sent to Pretty Big City to stop an asteroid.but that discovery is made only after the Mechas and friends have eaten the whole thing!

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Rakhi
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay want to make each other a rakhi, a protection bracelet. But first they need to decide who is the best protector!

programs.title: Bananas In Pyjamas
programs.desc: The Bananas have a busy day ahead. They've got things to do for Rat, then Bernard, then the Teddies. They wonder how they can do everything in one day. There's only one answer -  they'll have to do everything fast.

programs.title: Sesame Street
programs.desc: Welcome to Street Carnival Day! Cookie Monster is playing the Grover Game and needs to move ping pong balls off a plate without touching them. What if he blows through a tube to move the balls? Let's try!

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: With your help, Lachy greets Henry cheerfully with 'Hello, Henry!' However, during the song, Henry says something that Lachy struggles to understand. He calls Dr. Callum-Murray, will he be able to help?

programs.title: Andy and the Band
programs.desc: Leo and Jimi are locked in detention and will miss their gig - can the band bust them out?
